newsitem.title: UK: Dirty tanker rates steady to slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Dirty tanker rates steady to slightly firmer.

text.p: Dirty tanker chartering saw good activity in most regions on Thursday with most worldscale rates steady to slightly firmer, brokers said.

Mideast/Japan routes were assessed steady around W65 for 250,000 tonners with Mideast-West routes stable to soft at around W55 to W52.5, although the lower end of the scale was for a 285,000 cargo to the U.S. Gulf.
West African markets were quieter although rates held steady with transatlantic Suezmax tonnage taking around W95 and an 80,000 tonner to Italy taking a steady W102.5.

Transatlantic trade from the North Sea was also slow but U.K./Cont business remained active with rates for May voyages moving up around 15 points on Aframax tonnage. Cross-UKC trips were reported taking around W100 to W110, depending on timing.
Cross-Med rates were stable in active trade with business from Libya with Med UKC options taking W102.5 while Libya to Italy was valued around W100.
Caribs/upcoast U.S. fixtures were little changed, with 70,000 tonne vessels taking around W185/W187.5 for May trips.
